featured_reviews.name: DHANESH PATIDAR
featured_reviews.review_text: Gossip Corner Cafe and Restro offers a genuinely good theme and pleasant atmosphere, which initially set a positive tone for our visit. However, the experience was significantly marred by the unethical and unfair pricing of basic packaged commodities. Charging ₹50 for a bottled water with an MRP of ₹20 is a direct violation of consumer rules, and the markup on a Thums Up can from an MRP of ₹40 to ₹150 felt exorbitant and unjustified. While the restaurant's ambience was commendable, the extremely high and predatory pricing on these items is disappointing and makes the overall value proposition poor, overshadowing the positive experience of the theme and food.

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried the shawarma, and overall, it was quite good. The flavors were nice, and the spices were well-balanced, making it an enjoyable meal. featured_reviews.review_text:

The outlet is perfectly spaced with inside and outside spacious seating arrangements. The menu is perfectly set and there are a variety of food items available here like fried chicken drumsticks, classic momo, chicken tandoori, humus, Shawarma roll and open shawarma, veg rumali roti shawarma with different versions.
The marination spices, special seasoning and humus are made freshly in house here. Because of that all the food tastes unique and not common at all. The service is really very fast and good in the crowded situation also. The timing is afternoon from 2 PM to 10 PM till night.
You can order your food online by zomato or visiting the outlet. So I must visit and enjoy!

Friends , I have found a perfect hangout spot for all non vegetarians lovers in our own IC colony Borivali West. 312 house is famous for best shawarma , rolls and much more.

They have in-door and out-door seating area. The staff is also very friendly and jolly. The owner is also very helpful and sweet to talk.

We tried their highly recommended chicken cheese lava open shawarma where you will find loaded chicken along with layer of cheese sauce with pita bread sounds truly amazing.

They also offer best fried chicken options from their menu.

If you are a non veg lover dont miss this place out when you are in borivali.

It would 312 house overall 4/5 the experience was good the service was great and the aunty was very sweet and helpful.

Indulge in the exquisite flavors of chicken at 312 House, Borivali's gem for chicken enthusiasts. Offering a tantalizing array of dishes including juicy chicken rolls, flavorful tikkas, and more, this establishment has earned its reputation as one of the finest in the area.

Reasonable pricing adds to its appeal, making it a favorite among college students for group gatherings and parties. With shawarmas available from 1 pm onwards, it's the perfect spot for a satisfying meal any time of the day.

Our culinary journey at 312 House was nothing short of delightful. From the mouthwatering Open Makhni Chicken fries Shawarma to the innovative Chicken Popcorns, Each dish left a lasting impression. The fresh hummus paired perfectly with the flavorful Chicken pieces the peri peri momos and the Chicken Legs offered a satisfying crunch. Overall, it was an unforgettable experience exploring the diverse chicken options available.😍

The commendable service reflects the dedication of the owner's family, who ensure that every guest leaves delighted.❤

featured_reviews.name: Vimall P Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Culinary Journey for the Senses: The Global Veg Treat

In a world where vegetarian dining can sometimes feel repetitive, The Global Veg Treat emerges as a shining beacon of culinary innovation and flavor. This restaurant is not merely a place to eat; it is a destination for those who appreciate the art of plant-based cuisine, and my experience there was nothing short of exceptional.

Let’s start with the most important aspect: the food is an absolute delight. Each dish is a masterclass in flavor, showcasing a thoughtful "global" menu that lives up to its name. From the rich, creamy textures of a perfectly executed Indian paneer makhani to the fresh, zesty notes of a Mediterranean mezze platter, every bite was a journey. The ingredients tasted impeccably fresh, and the complex spice blends demonstrated a kitchen operating at a very high level. It’s the kind of food you crave days after your visit, a true testament to its delicious and memorable quality.

The experience is beautifully complemented by the restaurant's nice ambiance. The interior strikes a perfect balance between cozy and sophisticated, with warm lighting, comfortable seating, and tasteful decor that creates an inviting and relaxed atmosphere. It’s an ideal setting for everything from a quiet, intimate dinner to a celebratory meal with family and friends.

A crucial piece of advice that cannot be overstated: a reservation is absolutely needed. The well-deserved popularity of The Global Veg Treat means that tables are in high demand. Walking in on a whim, especially during weekends, will likely result in a lengthy wait. Planning ahead is a small price to pay for the guaranteed reward of a seamless and wonderful dining experience.

In conclusion, The Global Veg Treat has firmly secured its place as a top-tier vegetarian restaurant. With its sublime food, charming atmosphere, and evident popularity, it delivers on every promise. Do yourself a favor and book a table—your taste buds will thank you.

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Sizzling Spices in Dahisar with my friends this weekend, and it turned out to be a delightful experience for Asian food lovers. The place is small but cozy, with quick and humble service that makes you feel welcome.

We began with the Chicken Eight Treasure Soup, which was packed with a variety of vegetables along with chicken – light, healthy, and a good start. Next came the Korean-style Crispy Chicken, essentially chicken katsu paired with honey chilli sauce. While the sauce was average, the katsu itself was perfectly crispy and enjoyable.

The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the Chicken Thai Green Curry Pot Rice. Aromatic, rich in flavor, and served in a portion easily sufficient for three, it stood out as the star dish.

Overall, Sizzling Spices is a nice spot if you’re in the mood for hearty and flavorful Asian cuisine. Definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Danny Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently placed an order from Sizzling Spices, and the highlight of my meal was undeniably the Chicken Thai Pot Rice. This dish is a true testament to the restaurant's dedication to delivering authentic Thai flavors in a sizzling and satisfying way.
The presentation of the Chicken Thai Pot Rice was visually appealing, served in a sizzling hot pot. The aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water. The dish featured tender pieces of chicken, perfectly cooked and seasoned to perfection, accompanied by a generous serving of rice.
The Thai spices were expertly balanced, offering a delightful combination of sweet, sour, and spicy notes. Fresh herbs and vegetables added a refreshing crunch to each bite, while the fragrant lemongrass and coconut milk infused the dish with an authentic Thai essence.The portion size was generous, making it ideal for sharing or savoring as a satisfying meal. The sizzling pot kept the dish warm throughout the meal, ensuring that every bite was as enjoyable as the first.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place twice on 10th May'26. I always prefer buying things from a Maharashtrian place. My experiences were not that bad but at the same it was not so good which will make me visit you people again.

Visit 1) I bought dry snacks from you. I just informed the staff at the counter that the food item packets you sell, does not have basic details like MRP, Date of Packaging, Expiry, etc.. Most important FSSAI details were also missing. My only intention was just to caution the team so that it doesn't escalate in the future. But, I got a very blunt reply that it was prepared 2 days back and within 4 days it will be sold. Good confidence and my best wishes to you so that your every batch items gets sold in 4 days but, "Rules are Rules". Sell them loose if you don't want to spend money on printing.

Visit 2) We ordered food parcel for dinner and gave clear instructions on separate packing for 2 families. They packed everything in 1 single packet and did not take the efforts of informing us when we collected the parcel ourselves. The team messed up the packing and one of the family amongst us had to order few stuffs again. For a food delivery parcel worth 1000INR, you not give a carry bag mentioning that you don't keep bags . But for dry snacks you gave a good bag on the same evening.

Hope this review ends up with Sanata Management and they correct such experiences. Good luck!
